item.title: How My Little Server Grew a Front Door
item.description: ─── I run a personal server. It’s one machine, rented by the month, in a data center I will probably never visit. On it: a habit tracker, a finance ledger, a diary, a reading list, a file browser for my notes, a travel planner, and a few small tools I wrote because nothing else did the exact thing I wanted. It started as a hobby, and then somewhere along the way it stopped being one.
